text: 2026年9月11日，中国人民银行副行长、国家外汇管理局局长朱鹤新会见来访的香港证监会主席黄天祐、行政总裁梁凤仪。双方就巩固和提升香港国际金融中心地位、加强两地金融监管合作等议题进行了交流。国家外汇管理局副局长李斌陪同会见。（国家外汇局网站）
text_en: On September 11, 2026, Zhu Hexin, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, met with visiting Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission Chairman Tim Lui and Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung. The two sides exchanged views on consolidating and enhancing Hong Kong's status as an international financial center and strengthening cross-border financial regulatory cooperation, among other topics. SAFE Deputy Administrator Li Bin attended the meeting. (SAFE website)
